# onX Maps

> > onX Maps provides GPS navigation apps and mapping tools for backcountry skiing, mountain biking, off-roading, and outdoor recreation on public and private lands.

onX offers specialized outdoor navigation apps including onX Backcountry (skiing, hiking, mountain biking with Powder Project and MTB Project integrations), onX Offroad, and onX Hunt. The platform features offline maps, route planning, avalanche terrain ratings (ATES), property boundaries, and partnerships with conservation organizations like Leave No Trace and Student Conservation Association.

## Key Topics

- onX Backcountry
- Backcountry skiing and ski touring
- Public land access and landlocked acres
- Avalanche safety and ATES ratings
- Offline maps and route planning
- Powder Project and MTB Project integration
- Conservation partnerships (Leave No Trace, Student Conservation Association)
- State trust lands and regulations
- Guidebook content and ski zones
- Multi-day backpacking trips
- Mountain biking trails
- Colorado and Utah outdoor recreation
- onX Offroad features
- Beacon Guidebooks
- onX Backcountry Elite membership

## Product Features and Launches

- [onX Backcountry Launches Mountain Bike Mode with MTB Project Routes](https://www.onxmaps.com/blog/onx-backcountry-launches-mountain-bike-mode): Product launch: onX Backcountry adds MTB Mode with MTB Project trail data
- [onX Backcountry is Now Powered by Powder Project](https://www.onxmaps.com/backcountry/onx-backcountry-is-now-powered-by-powder-project): onX Backcountry integrates Powder Project for snow mode and ski routes
- [onX Offroad Launches A Suite Of New And Improved Features](https://www.onxmaps.com/blog/onx-offroad-launches-a-suite-of-new-and-improved-features-for-all-off-roaders): onX Offroad feature launch: My Garage, Offline Routing, weather layers

## Backcountry Skiing Guides

- [Explore Loveland Pass Backcountry Skiing](https://www.onxmaps.com/backcountry/skiing/loveland-pass): Loveland Pass ski guide with 108 routes across 17 backcountry zones
- [Explore Crystal Mountain Backcountry Skiing](https://www.onxmaps.com/backcountry/skiing/crystal-mountain): Crystal Mountain ski guide with 105 routes and 22 ski zones in Washington
- [Explore Monarch Pass Backcountry Skiing](https://www.onxmaps.com/backcountry/skiing/monarch-pass): Monarch Pass backcountry ski guide with 6 routes and terrain maps
- [The Fifty Project: Polar Star Couloir](https://www.onxmaps.com/backcountry/blog/the-fifty-polar-star): Cody Townsend's Fifty Project: Polar Star Couloir ski descent details
- [Girl Crush: A Human-Powered Adventure in the Tetons](https://www.onxmaps.com/backcountry/blog/girl-crush): Women's ski mountaineering expedition in Wyoming's Teton Range

## Backpacking and Hiking Guides

- [7 Bucket List Backpacking Trips in Colorado](https://www.onxmaps.com/backcountry/blog/7-bucket-list-backpacking-trips-in-colorado): Colorado backpacking guide featuring 7 must-do multi-day hiking trips
- [3 Bucket List Backpacking Trips in Utah](https://www.onxmaps.com/backcountry/blog/3-bucket-list-backpacking-trips-in-utah): Utah backpacking guide with 3 wilderness trips including South Willow Lake

## Public Land Access and Regulations

- [How 15 Million Inaccessible Acres of Public Lands Impact Outdoor Recreation](https://www.onxmaps.com/blog/15-million-inaccessible-acres-public-land-impact-outdoor-recreation): Analysis of landlocked public lands and access barriers in Western states
- [How a 23-Acre Purchase Opened 13,000 Acres of Public Land in Idaho](https://www.onxmaps.com/blog/public-land-unlocked-on-elk-mountain-idaho): Eric Siegfried and RMEF unlock 13,000 acres on Idaho's Elk Mountain
- [State Trust Land: History, Regulations, Allowed Activities](https://www.onxmaps.com/blog/state-trust-land-history-regulations-activities-and-more): State trust land guide: history, regulations, and outdoor recreation access
- [Top 5 States to Cut Down a Christmas Tree on Public Land](https://www.onxmaps.com/blog/top-states-for-public-land-christmas-trees): Guide to cutting Christmas trees on public land with permit info
